Seat ruling at 2026-11-15T14:12Z, after an independent review: **B′ — the producer declares `userMessage`.** Seat-level; no maintainer card.

- `DuplicateRecordError` declares its already-assembled end-user sentence as `userMessage`. Every boundary already forwards a declared `userMessage` (`declaredUserMessage` in `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`, the actions door, Hono, flow inner refusal, MCP), so all doors get it in one place. `message` stays the diagnostic text; the action-door and batch-row pins that keep `message` as the thrown one stay as they are.
- `toRowApiError` carries `userMessage` on row errors (createMany, updateMany, batch, upsert); `ApiError` already has the key.
- /data 409 gains `userMessage` (same text as `error`): flip `engine-duplicate-record-label-sentence.test.ts:412` and update the note at `duplicate-record-error.ts:110-114`. Clause-②: yes (widening). Contract review record owed.
- Not A: A puts the user sentence into the diagnostic `message` slot and needs rewriting three written rules and flipping pins.
- Add a pin for the sandbox script write path (`quickjs-runner.ts` hand-back), which the report did not cover. The PR lists every door as changed or declared unchanged.

Basis: maintainer ruling C on #32440 (6819749037: end-user text in the request language, assembled at the producer) with carrier #32654 (`ApiErrorSchema.userMessage`). #33348 left exactly this question open and is not a ruling. Precedent for the key: `packaged-permission-set-lock.ts:447,471`, `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts:330-331`, in-flight PR #33884 (SKILL.md:216, precedent named).

Prior rulings read: #33790 body + comment; PR #33348 + reviews 6881384349, 6882141560; #33213; #32440 (6819513436, 6819749037); #32654 + children; PR #33884; contract.zod.ts userMessage text.
